entities.name: Casindral
entities.description: Historically significant region and nation of southern Corondor on Dominaria, between Stonehaven and Golthonor, dominated by open plains.

entities.name: Casindral Isle
entities.description: Island south of the mainland regarded as a favorable omen; harbor for merchant, pleasure and pirate ships and arrival site for refugees from Jamuura.

entities.name: Cape of Casindral
entities.description: Coastal landmark between Stonehaven and Golthonor.

entities.name: Kristina's Woods
entities.description: Woodland associated with the alliance defending Casindral against Ravidel.

entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: Small kingdom with a long history of conflict, west of the Great Salt Marshes.

entities.name: The White Woods
entities.description: Forest within the Quirion Sovereign, refuge for Elves of Terisiare.

entities.name: Quirion
entities.description: Resilient elven nation extending to Corondor's southern coasts.

entities.name: River Estolade
entities.description: River through the White Woods with Quirion settlements.
